query_scope: Read-only reconstructed source count/frequency-key/20-ID page queries with fixed captured Exact filters; corrected inbox membership key; source schema audio arm absent throughout
policy: Independent transactions per window; historical concurrent changes accepted by user; distinct keys merged exactly

method.explain: ANALYZE, BUFFERS, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY ON, FORMAT JSON

limitations: Two captured Exact terms and one synthetic no-match control; not all search modes/filter distributions.
Captured SQL filter context, not full original UI POST payload; simplified eligible-message query rather than complete endpoint SQL.
Calendar intervals computed in UTC; historical counts on a fixed parent period.
Cache and concurrent production work were uncontrolled; run order was varied without forcing eviction.
Timed-out probes are lower bounds at eight seconds; no conclusion about their completion before the installed fifty-second application SQL timeout.
Page timings select IDs only; hydration/enrichment, HTTP/UI/queue concurrency and other sort bases are not measured.
The body index was valid; use depends on the diagnostic shape.
No production defaults, indexes, statistics, services or analytics metadata changed.
